chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Ch. 291: The Zuowandao’s Ultimate Trick – Self-Deception
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang survives an ambush of animated clay statues only to be stabbed in the back by Blind Chen. But the assassin is a Zuowandao who has mastered a terrifying new art: lying to itself.
og_description: A Liar Who Believes His Own Lies – The Zuowandao unveils a new level of psychological horror.
twitter_description: Blind Chen turns traitor? No—he’s been replaced by a Zuowandao using a technique that terrifies even Li Huowang.

lore_anchors.definition: A round Daoist ritual mirror inscribed with the eight trigrams; used to reflect and dispel evil spirits, often empowered by blood sacrifice in this novel.
The "Way of Sitting in Forgetfulness." A cult of pathological liars who have twisted a classical Daoist meditative concept into a weapon of cognitive and spiritual deception.
A rare and dangerous human constitution; those born with it can reshape reality through belief, making them both incredibly valuable and incredibly vulnerable to predation.
Eyes of two different colors; in this novel, they are a signature physical trait of Li Huowang and a mark of his Heart-Element nature.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did the Zuowandao impersonate Blind Chen so perfectly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It used a new technique: lying to itself. By fully believing it *was* Blind Chen, it bypassed both supernatural detection and its own body's tells, achieving a perfect physical and spiritual disguise.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the impostor say it learned the trick from Li Huowang?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Li Huowang's Heart-Element nature lets him reshape reality through belief. The Zuowandao observed this and adapted the principle for its own deceptive purposes—turning self-deception into a weapon.
